controller: iPhone Mirroring through computer-use with CoreDevice cold relaunch
stakeholder_scope_decision: Camera testing is not required; verify parsing through an uploaded or used image.

observed: Japanese regions were highlighted in blue while English, digits, and the synthetic fixture marker remained unhighlighted.
Selecting 静か produced an inline しず / 静か / quiet, silent gloss.
Selecting the inline gloss opened Word Detail with a Photo back route and an image attachment context thumbnail.
Back restored the image result with no token selected.
The recognition control toggled all blue highlights off and on.
Share exposed Copy Text and Share Image; Copy Text dismissed the menu, while its device-local payload was not readable through the current authority.
Close returned to Search root without confirmation or visible retained image state.
Nihongo highlighted multiple vertical Japanese tokens and left other kana and punctuation unhighlighted.
Selecting blue 読 produced 読本 / reading-book, reader, guide…, combining adjacent-column 本 rather than following the fixture's vertical reading order.
Nihongo opened a three-page result carousel.
The no-text image produced a No Text Found alert; OK retained the empty page and allowed carousel navigation.
Selecting the second page indicator showed noisy low-contrast text with the same material Japanese highlights as the clear fixture.
Selecting the third page indicator showed the sparse 静 glyph highlighted in full.
Selecting 静 produced せい / 静 / stillness.
Cold relaunch discarded the active carousel and returned to the empty Search root.

cleanup.device_files_removal: Moved to Files Recently Deleted through the normal recoverable delete action; the two unrelated Downloads items remained untouched.
cleanup.mac_unsynced_staging_folder: Moved to Trash after iCloud Drive was found disabled.

privacy: Only purpose-created fixture and public dictionary evidence was retained. The Photo Library picker was cancelled immediately and no picker screenshot was copied into the dossier. Files-picker evidence containing unrelated items was not retained. All nine synthetic device files were removed after capture.
